richiami.difetto: The hood wing may have been incorrectly attached to the front bumper during manufacturing. In such cases, the hood wing could come loose and detach while driving, which can lead to injuries. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of Motor Vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Distributor · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: 21/08/2025
richiami.titolo: The hood wing may have been incorrectly attached to the front bumper during manufacturing.

traduzione.difetto: Il paraurti anteriore potrebbe essere stato montato in modo errato sul paraurti anteriore durante la produzione. In tali casi, il paraurti anteriore potrebbe staccarsi e separarsi durante la guida, il che può causare lesioni. Il prodotto non risponde al Regolamento sulla approvazione e sorveglianza del mercato dei veicoli a motore e dei loro rimorchi, e dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.
traduzione.rimedio: Tipo di operatore economico che ha adottato misura(i) notificata(e): Distributore · Categoria della misura(i): Ritiro del prodotto dagli utenti finali · Data di entrata in vigore: 21/08/2025
traduzione.titolo: Il paraurti anteriore potrebbe essere stato montato in modo errato sul paraurti anteriore durante la produzione.

richiami.difetto: Due to moisture ingress in a connector housing, the internal pins can corrode. This can result in electrical malfunctions, such as parking brake engagement issues, start-up difficulties, loss of power steering assist or multiple warning messages. A loss of power steering assist increases the risk of accidents and injuries.  The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: 10/07/2025
richiami.titolo: Due to moisture ingress in a connector housing, the internal pins can corrode.

traduzione.difetto: A causa dell'ingresso di umidità nel contenitore di un connettore, le pin interne possono corrodersi. Ciò può provocare malfunzionamenti elettrici, come problemi nell'attivazione del freno a mano, difficoltà di avviamento, perdita dell'assistenza al volante o più messaggi di avviso. La perdita dell'assistenza al volante aumenta il rischio di incidenti e lesioni. Il prodotto non risponde al Regolamento sulla omologazione e la sorveglianza del mercato dei veicoli a motore e dei loro rimorchi, nonché dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.
traduzione.rimedio: Tipo di operatore economico che ha adottato misura(i) notificata(e): Produttore · Categoria della misura(i): Ritiro del prodotto dagli utenti finali · Data di entrata in vigore: 10/07/2025
traduzione.titolo: A causa dell'ingresso di umidità nel contenitore di un connettore, le pin interne possono corrodersi.

This can lead to a collision and increase the risk of accidents and injuries. The product does not comply with Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Distributor · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: 30/06/2025

Ciò può portare a un incidente e aumentare il rischio di incidenti e lesioni. Il prodotto non risponde al Regolamento sulla omologazione e sul controllo del mercato dei veicoli a motore e dei loro rimorchi, nonché dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.
traduzione.rimedio: Tipo di operatore economico che ha adottato la misura(o) notificata: Distributore · Categoria della misura(o): Ritiro del prodotto dagli utenti finali · Data di entrata in vigore: 30/06/2025

richiami.difetto: On affected vehicles there is an issue with the inline connector that joins the bumper wiring harness and the engine bay harness. There is a risk of fluid ingress into the connector housing resulting in corrosion of the connector pins.
richiami.rimedio: Replace the bumper wiring harness and the inline connector on the engine bay harness.
richiami.titolo: RP1063 PS3 Cable Harness Replacement

richiami.difetto: Affected vehicles may experience a temporary loss of braking functionality after coasting downhill when using One Pedal Drive. This could potentially lead to a collision.
richiami.rimedio: Install modified software via an Over the Air (OTA) update.
richiami.titolo: BCM2 SW – Safety Notice

richiami.difetto: On affected vehicles the Far-Side Airbag (FSAB) in the left-hand front seat of the car may fail to deploy as intended increasing the risk of injury in impacts from the right-hand side of the vehicle.
richiami.rimedio: Replace the Far-Side Airbag (FSAB).
richiami.titolo: PS2 FSAB

richiami.difetto: On affected vehicles a fault within the High to Low voltage Converter Module (HLCM) reduces the available charging capacity to the 12V battery. In a worst-case scenario this could cause the vehicle to lose propulsion power without any prior warning message to the driver.
richiami.rimedio: Replace the High to Low voltage Converter Module (HLCM).
richiami.titolo: PS3 HLCM Replacement

richiami.difetto: One of the bolts holding the front left seat can be improperly fitted. This can increase the risk of injuries, in the event of a crash. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Distributor · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: 01/07/2024
richiami.titolo: One of the bolts holding the front left seat can be improperly fitted.

traduzione.difetto: Uno dei bulloni che tiene il sedile anteriore sinistro può essere montato in modo improprio. Ciò può aumentare il rischio di lesioni, in caso di incidente. Il prodotto non risponde al Regolamento sull'approvazione e la sorveglianza del mercato dei veicoli a motore e dei loro rimorchi, nonché dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.
traduzione.rimedio: Tipo di operatore economico che ha adottato la misura(o) notificata: Distributore · Categoria della misura(o): Ritiro del prodotto dagli utenti finali · Data di entrata in vigore: 01/07/2024
traduzione.titolo: Uno dei bulloni che tiene il sedile anteriore sinistro può essere montato in modo improprio.

richiami.difetto: On affected vehicles it has been identified that the four bolts on the left front seat may not have been torqued correctly at the factory.
richiami.rimedio: On the affected vehicles Inspection the torque of all four bolts will be carried out and if necessary adjust the torque to the correct specification.
richiami.titolo: PS2 Seat Bolts

richiami.difetto: A front suspension bearing can detach which can affect the manoeuvrability of the vehicle, creating a risk of an accident.  The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: A front suspension bearing can detach which can affect the manoeuvrability of the vehicle, creating a risk of an accident.

richiami.difetto: A joint in the front suspension may have been incorrectly attached during the manufacturing process.
richiami.rimedio: Inspect the front suspension to ensure that the joint is correctly attached and if applicable adjust accordingly.
richiami.titolo: A joint in the front suspension may have been incorrectly attached during the manufacturing process.

richiami.difetto: There is a potential for the high voltage battery to overheat when fully charged and the vehicle remains plugged in once full charge is reached.
richiami.rimedio: Replace the battery cell modules and restore the electric driving range to full capacity if the temporary software fix from R10202 has been previously downloaded to the vehicle.
richiami.titolo: There is a potential for the high voltage battery to overheat when fully charged and the vehicle remains plugged in once full charge is reached.

richiami.difetto: High voltage battery cells can overheat when the battery is fully charged. This can lead to a thermal event inside the battery, increasing the risk of fire. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Importer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: High voltage battery cells can overheat when the battery is fully charged.

richiami.difetto: Investigations have identified that there may be a potential issue with the high-voltage battery.
richiami.rimedio: As an interim solution due to hardware component availability issues software should be downloaded to the vehicle which will prevent the battery from being fully charged.
richiami.titolo: Investigations have identified that there may be a potential issue with the high-voltage battery.

richiami.difetto: The vehicle may, under certain circumstances, experience loss of propulsion while driving.This will increase the risk of an accident.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Distributor · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: 01/03/2021
richiami.titolo: The vehicle may, under certain circumstances, experience loss of propulsion while driving.This will increase the risk of an accident.

richiami.difetto: High voltage contactors may open during driving resulting in a risk that the high voltage system may be unintentionally disconnected causing a loss of propulsion.
richiami.rimedio: Software upgrade to be carried out.
richiami.titolo: HIGH VOLTAGE CONTACTORS IN THE BATTERY ENERGY CONTROL MODULE MAY OPEN DURING DRIVING

richiami.difetto: Under certain circumstances, the vehicle will not start or will lose power/drive without prior notice, increasing the risk of an accident.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Distributor · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: 09/11/2020
richiami.titolo: Under certain circumstances, the vehicle will not start or will lose power/drive without prior notice, increasing the risk of an accident.

richiami.difetto: The headlights may have been set too high.This can blind the drivers of oncoming vehicles, increasing the risk of an accident.

richiami.titolo: The headlights may have been set too high.This can blind the drivers of oncoming vehicles, increasing the risk of an accident.

richiami.difetto: Tin plating on the bulk capacitor terminals may create a short circuit
richiami.rimedio: Replace the affected inverters as appropriate
richiami.titolo: TIN PLATING ON BULK CAPACITOR TERMINALS COULD CAUSE SHORT CURCUIT AND STALLING WHILE DRIVING

richiami.difetto: An internal reset in the Battery Energy Control Module (BECM) causes the control unit to open the high voltage connectors during driving.
richiami.rimedio: Download upgraded software.
richiami.titolo: AN INTERNAL RESET IN THE BATTERY ENERGY CONTROL MODULE CAUSES THE CONTROL UNIT TO OPEN THE HIGH VOLTAGE CONECTORS DURING DRIVING

richiami.difetto: The headlamps are adjusted too high.
richiami.rimedio: Adjust the headlamps to the correct level.
